candidate_windows.window_text: For ReCo, we use the pre-trained BERT-base (Devlin et al., 2019; Cui et al., 2020) as the encoder to encode events and contexts. The batch size is set to 24, the dimension $m$ is 256, we choose Adam (Kingma and Ba, 2014) as the optimizer with a learning rate of $1e - 5$ . The loss coefficients $\lambda_{1}$ and $\lambda_{2}$ are 1 and 0.01, respectively. ReCo runs 50 epochs on two Tesla-P100-16gb GPUs.
